rule: Typed receivers (decision A, all statically typed languages and typed PHP/Groovy declarations): a receiver whose type is given by a declaration — local, parameter, field/property (including `$var->prop` / `obj.field` chains whose property has a declared type), catch parameter, for-loop variable, pattern binding — or by `= new T(...)` gives `T#m` (high if defined in the scan, else medium).
source: KNOWN_GAP: typed properties declared on a superclass are not used
notes: $this->logger is the property declared `protected Logger $logger` on the scanned superclass App\BaseCtl; the declaration gives its type, so the receiver is App.Logger → App.Logger#info, high. A `logger.info` low guess is wrong. call_type: SPEC lists direct|method without defining them; this corpus uses method for every callee of the form Type#m / recv.m / .m (instance and static member calls) and direct for free functions, bare names and named nested functions.
